item.title: Diversion Traffic Through Residential Road, 21st August
item.description:
I am writing to raise a serious concern regarding the current road closure and the resulting diversion of traffic through residential road. Since the London road has been closed, a significant amount of traffic has been diverted onto Strickland Rd, This includes heavy vehicles such as large tipper/dump trucks, as well as cars travelling at excessive speeds. Our road is a narrow residential road, predominantly consisting of bungalows and home to many senior residents. The road is already particularly narrow because vehicles are regularly parked along one side, leaving very limited space for passing traffic. The significant increase in traffic is therefore creating a serious safety concern for residents and pedestrians.In addition to the safety concerns, the increased traffic has also caused a considerable increase in noise, including during the night. The noise from passing vehicles is having a significant impact on residents' quality of life.There is a more suitable road further along king alfred way leads towards to London road which appears to be much more appropriate for diverted traffic, particularly heavy vehicles. We would therefore strongly request that the current diversion route is reviewed. Could the Council please consider installing appropriate temporary diversion signs to direct traffic towards the more suitable industrial-area route, rather than through this narrow residential road?We would also appreciate it if the Council could review the current traffic situation and consider whether any additional traffic management or road safety measures are necessary. This situation is becoming increasingly concerning for local residents, and we would be grateful if this matter could be treated as a priority. Thank you for your attention. I look forward to hearing from you regarding what action can be taken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 16, Strickland Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Missing NO THROUGH ROAD Sign on Upper Park Street, 21st August
item.description:
The No Through Road sign on Upper Park Street, Cheltenham GL52 is missing. As the street has no turning circle at the end, this is causing difficulties for drivers who enter it by mistake. Following the recent burst water main on London Road (19 September 2026), an increasing number of vehicles have been entering Upper Park Street. Drivers appear to assume that it runs parallel to London Road and provides a route back to the A40, only to find it is a dead end. Please could you arrange for the missing sign to replaced as soon as possible?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 18, Upper Park Street, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
